image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a baked meatloaf in a dark baking pan. The loaf is oblong with a domed top, covered in a glossy, reddish-brown glaze that appears caramelized and slightly sticky. The surface texture shows the granularity of ground meat beneath the sauce. A slice has been removed from the left side, revealing the dense, cooked interior structure. The lighting highlights the sheen of the glaze.
